title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-03-30

ai_review.summary: Muffled but solid soundboard capture of an intense early‑68 show, highlighted by a smoking Other One → Dark Star and a fiery Eleven.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its high energy, with The Other One flowing into one of the finest pre‑8/68 Dark Stars, plus a hot Eleven and sparkling China Cat. Recording quality is decent for a 1968 soundboard – a bit muffled and distant, and Pigpen's keyboards are muted, but overall it remains listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews consistently note strong musical moments (high show rating) while acknowledging some muffled audio and keyboard issues (moderate recording rating). Weighted average yields ~4.3.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Muffled, distant ‘airy’ sound typical of early SBDs; Pigpen's keyboard muted; some transitions (China Cat → Eleven, Born Cross‑Eyed → Spanish Jam) not perfectly smooth.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall strong set with high‑energy jams, though a few song transitions (e.g., China Cat → Eleven) are less smooth.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Intense guitar work; solo style noticeably different from 1966 versions, praised for fire on The Other One and Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's keyboard is muted, reducing the typical 1968 organ presence.
